correctness.rationale: The augmented affine determinant has two orthogonal 2-plane factors: \(\operatorname{area}(\text{square triple})\,|\det(\text{pentagon pair})|/12\), or \(|\det(\text{square pair})|\,\operatorname{area}(\text{pentagon triple})/12\). The 3+2 split gives twenty each at \(s/12,t/12\). The 2+3 split gives twenty each at \((2s-t)/24,(s+2t)/24\) and twenty zero; remaining splits give twenty-six zero, so 46+4*20=126. Divide by Medgyes’ \(5s/6\) and \(t/s=(\sqrt5-1)/2\) to obtain exact strict order and golden-ratio fractions. Successive vertex replacements maximize separately absolute-affine determinants, proving global contained-simplex maximum. Fresh verifier enumerates all 126 distinct vertex 5-subsets by direct permutation determinant.
